metadata.title: Shortest closed geodesics on three-dimensional isospectral manifolds
metadata.abstract: We prove that the spectrum of a smooth closed three-manifold gives a positive lower bound for the length of its shortest nonconstant closed geodesic. The argument uses three curvature heat coefficients and the first positive singularity of the retarded wave trace. The heat coefficients yield a curvature--length dichotomy: sufficiently large maximum curvature forces a closed geodesic shorter than the curvature scale. We then show that a shortest closed geodesic lying below the conjugate radius produces a singularity of the sine trace. Combining these estimates gives a lower bound depending only on the common spectrum. The compactness theorem of Anderson then implies smooth compactness of the full isospectral family modulo diffeomorphisms.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 三维等谱流形的闭测地线控制
analysis.workSummary: 作者利用前三个相关曲率热系数与延迟波迹，证明闭三流形的共同谱控制最短非平凡闭测地线的正下界，并推出等谱族模微分同胚光滑紧性。
analysis.breakthrough: 把谱数据连接到闭测地线长度和三维等谱族几何紧性。
analysis.limitations: 维数三和闭光滑背景关键；热系数到曲率尺度的步骤需按正文精确条件理解。
analysis.priorityReason: 把谱数据连接到闭测地线长度和三维等谱族几何紧性。
